catalogue_header_discrepancy.header_reading: Plate LXXIV. Copper and Bronze Tools and Implements (Groups2529,2593). ChapterXII
catalogue_header_discrepancy.finding: The group header lists2529 and2593 but omits2596, although the first exact item row is2596A. Later item rows10–17 belong2593; the header is incomplete with respect to the axe row rather than evidence that2596A should be changed to2593A.
catalogue_header_discrepancy.policy: Retain header and exact row separately; identity/context use item-level record, corroborated by p43 pan2596. No silent correction or inferred typographical cause.
